subtitle: Master the Art of Alchemy
promotional_text: Elixir Atelier: master the ancient art of potion brewing. Mix ingredients, control temperature, and craft legendary elixirs in your medieval alchemist laboratory.
description: Elixir Atelier is a premium alchemy crafting game with a golden medieval aesthetic. You play a master alchemist and fulfill brewing orders from travelers, academies, and wizards. Brewing has four phases: mix ingredients in the cauldron, control temperature, stir, and bottle the creation. There are 52 ingredients across Minerals, Plants, Liquids, and Creatures, each with rarity from Common to Legendary, elemental affinity, and stat values. Craft 14 recipes from simple Healing Potions to legendary Elixirs of Life, from starter formulas to rare brews. Accept orders from 5 customer types, from Village Healers to Ancient Wizards, with requirements, time limits, and rewards. Quality is scored from 0 to 100 percent; higher quality pays more coins and experience and unlocks recipes. The look uses warm colors, parchment textures, and ornate details. Play is fully offline, with no ads and no in-app purchases. Also included: an ingredient vault, free ingredient selection, and statistics for potions brewed, perfect brews, and orders completed.
app_review_notes: Elixir Atelier is an offline alchemy crafting game. Players select ingredients, complete a 4-phase brewing mini-game of mixing, heating, stirring, and bottling, and earn rewards based on quality. No sign-in is required. It includes order fulfillment, progression tracking, and collection. It is a crafting simulation with a golden medieval look, not a memory or matching game.
